title: PEZ Candy Dispenser Reindeer Head - Brown, Used Collectible
descriptionText: The Pez Candy Dispenser Reindeer Head is a fun and festive toy featuring a brown color scheme. Perfect for fans of the PEZ franchise, this candy dispenser is sure to bring joy to both children and collectors alike. With its unique design and character of a reindeer, this dispenser adds a playful touch to the world of action figures and accessories.
